# Inconsolata terminal font

Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/inconsolata
File: Inconsolata[wdth,wght].ttf (bundled as res/font/inconsolata.ttf)
Retrieved: 2026-11-03
SHA-256: 23ded25b447074d00659392bf9b1123d89df55cb07b0ad9bfef3366d199b5fcb
License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, see OFL.txt.

Uses the font's normal-width, regular-weight default. No horizontal Canvas stretch,
synthetic condensation, or programming ligatures are applied. Android provides CJK
fallback; the terminal keeps two-cell wide-character semantics. Font size follows sp.
